headSubject: chore(ledger): confirm REG-218/REG-223 fixes through a real browser pass, not just REST
summary: Closed out REG-222 (rewrote WmsOffice's two plugin capability files to remove lambdas/method references, satisfying the B30 LambdaMetafactory ban -- app now boots clean) and, while re-verifying REG-218 survives a fresh build, found and fixed REG-218 itself plus a second stacked bug REG-223 in ManifestDrivenJavaSourcePluginHandler (isolated plugin:java-source dispatch: a case-exact operation lookup against always-lowercased manifest keys, and a hardcoded single-Map-arg method resolution that silently picked the wrong overload and dropped extra arguments) -- both fixed to match the already-correct in-process sibling handler, unit-tested (3/3 green), and confirmed end-to-end via real ScrapForAI browser clicks on the actual Inventario 'Importar Contagem' and CrossDocking 'Importar (Parse Romaneio)' buttons.
nextStep: No specific carried-over step -- REG-222/REG-218/REG-223 are all DONE and the WMS-9 sweep's C4 checklist item is now PASS. The next open items from the mega roadmap / ledger are REG-216, REG-217, SEC-11, WMS-11, QUAL-40, QUAL-41 (see ledger/session-state/open-state.md for current detail on each) -- none of these were touched this session, so pick per priority rather than assuming continuity. If resuming WMS-9's own sweep specifically: C5 (CrossDocking Expedicao-side auto-generation) remains a source-confirmed design gap with no fix attempted, and I5-I8/C8/C10/N-series/Z-series items from the 2026-09-19 sweep note still need their own follow-through per WMS-9.yml's own 'remaining open decisions' paragraph.
verified: Narrow, not full gates: NPDevRuntimeHost/runtimehost-core gradlew test --tests com.finalexec.pluginipc.ManifestDrivenJavaSourcePluginHandlerTest (BUILD SUCCESSFUL, 3/3 green, 0 failures/0 errors). Live verification: wmsoffice-browser-v2 rebuilt+rebooted three times across the session (REG-222 boot-clean check, REG-218 pre/post-fix REST repro, REG-223 pre/post-fix REST repro), boot logs grepped for zero B30/JAVA_SOURCE_OPERATION_NOT_BOUND matches after each fix. Real-browser confirmation via ScrapForAI (background subagent): actual clicks on InventarioArquivoAggregateWorkbench's 'Importar Contagem (Parse)' and RomaneioAggregateWorkbench's 'Importar (Parse Romaneio)' buttons both rendered real populated grid rows with zero console/page errors and zero JAVA_SOURCE_OPERATION_NOT_BOUND text (screenshots saved under D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\Build\scrapforai-artifacts\). No full quality gate run this session -- targeted platform fixes only, per project norms.
